name: driftleaf
description: So your thoughts don't drift. A local-first, encrypted-by-default notes app.

scripts.package:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.yml --linux AppImage --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.yml --linux --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:linux:rpm: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.yml --linux rpm --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.yml --linux --arm64 --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:linux:beta: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.beta.yml --linux --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:macos: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/macos.yml --mac dmg --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:macos:beta: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/macos.beta.yml --mac dmg --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/windows.yml --win nsis portable --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.package:windows:beta: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/windows.beta.yml --win nsis portable --publish never -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.publish:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/linux.yml --linux --publish always -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.publish:macos: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/macos.yml --mac dmg --publish always -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
scripts.publish:windows: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder/windows.yml --win nsis portable --publish always -c.electronVersion=43.1.0
